title: Hexta Hook Manifest
description: Manifest for a future Hexta app or extension that consumes Hexta's public API and event surface. The contract is defined now so the standalone core can later expose app/extension modes without restructuring.

manifest_version.description: Version of this manifest contract. Currently only 1.

id.description: Reverse-dns or dotted id used to correlate audit events, e.g. 'com.hexa.loan-toolkit' or 'hexa.va-helper'.

kind.description: app = independent client that talks to the Hexta REST API. extension = embedded surface (browser/IDE) that hooks into Hexta events/tools.

entry.description: Primary entry point. For an app: the start URL/scheme. For an extension: the injected script/module or tool id. Present so a future registry can bootstrap the consumer.

auth.description: How the consumer authenticates (see hooks/contracts/ for the JWT flow).

flow.description: password = /api/v1/auth/login then store the bearer JWT. bearer = already has a token handed to it by the host.

hooks.description: Event surface the consumer subscribes to (extension kind). Each value is the event name emitted by the Hexta core.

permissions.description: Declared capabilities. Future enforcement may check these against an allow-list. When empty, the consumer is read-only observer.
